title: Broad Creek Marina
specs: Located in the center of Hilton Head Island on Broad Creek, convenient to Atlantic Ocean
53 wet slips for boats up to 55 feet, two slips for vessels up to 100 feet
State-of-the-art dry storage facility with 24-hour security and sprinkler system
On-site ASE certified mechanics and full-service body shop

blurb: Broad Creek Marina provides wet slips for boats up to 55 feet and dry storage for boats up to 35 feet and 14,000 lbs. The marina offers mechanical and body shop services, a marina store, laundry, restrooms, showers, and a pub and grill. Water sports and nature activities such as dolphin cruises, sailboat charters, parasailing, jet skiing, fishing charters, and kayaking are available from the docks.
extraNote: Call for updates on availability and rates · Broad Creek Marina docks at 18 Simmons Road, Hilton Head Island, SC 29926
